author: reek
body: A capability effect may carry a scope literal naming the resources the grant covers. This opening promises it reads only under "/config/" and then reaches for /etc/passwd. The scope literal has always parsed and ridden the effect label; until CDX4002 was raised, nothing read it, so this program compiled and the promise meant nothing.

author: reek
body: A scope may narrow, never widen.

author: reek
body: The scope check keys on the name of the operation, not on whether the compiler happens to emit it as a builtin. Moving file-exists out of the emitter and into Foreword chapter Fat16 -- where a question about a filesystem belongs -- therefore leaves this refusal exactly where it was, and proving that is now part of what this test is for.
